name: smalltalk-agent
description: MCP server for AI interaction with live Smalltalk images (Squeak and Cuis). Delegates Smalltalk tasks to a locally-configured LLM — no source code leaves your machine. The agent has access to 14 VM tools: evaluate, browse, define, modify, save, and more.
long_description:
Connect Claude to a live Smalltalk programming environment via a secure agent architecture. All Smalltalk code interaction is handled by a locally-configured LLM (e.g. Ollama) — no proprietary source code leaves your machine.

Claude sends high-level task descriptions to an autonomous agent that uses your chosen LLM to browse classes, read source, evaluate expressions, and define methods against a running Smalltalk image.

Supports two transport modes:
- **TCP** (recommended): Token-authenticated TCP connection to Squeak's built-in MCP server
- **MQTT**: Remote images via MQTT broker

Supports four LLM providers: Ollama (free, local), Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI.

Works with Squeak and Cuis Smalltalk images.
